exact_activation_phrase: visible claim toward another adult's owned object

required_evidence.object_phrase: one primary object remains visibly held or worn by its current adult owner
required_evidence.claim_phrase: another adult makes an overt claim exchange bid or reach toward that same object
required_evidence.owner_response_phrase: the current owner pulls protects refuses or withholds the object through action
required_evidence.geometry_phrase: claimant object and owner form one readable ownership-boundary triangle
required_evidence.continuity_phrase: the object never loses continuity with the owner during the claim

render_gates.description: One primary object is visibly held or worn by its current adult owner.
Another adult performs an overt claim, bid, or boundary-crossing reach toward that object.
The current owner's protection, refusal, consideration, or withholding is visible as action.
Claimant, object, and owner form one readable ownership-boundary relation.
The object remains continuously linked to the owner during the claim.
